problem.statement: Lane 0 evidence and changed-path verification must remain deterministic in fresh Windows and Unix clones without hidden pull-request refs.
successCriteria: A fresh Windows clone with default core.autocrlf passes the Lane 0 closeout gate without fetching pull-request refs
A fresh macOS or Linux clone passes the same gate without fetching pull-request refs
Every Lane 0 evidence worktree byte hash equals its authoritative Git object hash on both platforms

definitionOfDone.claim: the Lane 0 closeout gate passes on a fresh clone with no refs/pull/* fetched, on both Windows default core.autocrlf and a Unix clone
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: clone fresh on each platform, fetch no PR refs, run the gate; any FAIL falsifies; a pass that requires fetching a pull ref falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: evidence byte-hashes are identical between object store and worktree on every platform
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: for each file in the evidence dir, git cat-file -p HEAD:<path> | sha256sum must equal the worktree sha256sum; any divergence falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: the changed-path proof is derived only from commits reachable from main
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: any git object the gate requires that is unreachable from origin/main falsifies

confidence.biggestRisk: A superficially green repair could still depend on an ambient Git object or silently weaken the sealed evidence proof.
confidence.nextAction: Prove both baseline failures, add red regression tests, and repair only the two durability defects.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: That would preserve the hidden-object dependency and make gate truth depend on ambient repository history.

rejectedAlternatives.idea: Exclude evidence files from manifest verification
rejectedAlternatives.reason: That would remove the proof instead of preserving byte-exact checkout fidelity.
